read.title: Project Status Update
read.text:
The website redesign project is mostly on track. The design team finished the new home page last week, and user testing will begin on Monday. However, there is a two-week delay in the payment system because the vendor changed its software version.

To avoid further delays, we will prioritize the payment work and move the blog update to the next phase. The final deliverable, a fully working website, is now expected on September 30 instead of September 16.

If you have concerns about the new schedule, please contact the project office by Friday.

write.task: 팀장님이 보고서 진행 상황을 물었어요. 조금 늦어지는 이유와 언제까지 끝낼 수 있는지 답장을 써 보세요.
write.en: Reply to your manager: explain why your report is a little late and when you can finish it.
write.model:
Hi Jenny,

Thanks for checking in. I'm running a little behind on the report because I'm still waiting for the final numbers from finance. I'll prioritize it tomorrow and send you the draft by Thursday noon. I'll keep you posted if anything changes.

Thanks,
Minsu
